title: ostericum sieboldii f. hirtulum
intro: Ostericum sieboldii f. hirtulum, commonly known as Siebold's angelica or Korean angelica, is a plant species within the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in relieving pain, reducing fever, and protecting against infections. The therapeutic actions of Ostericum sieboldii f. hirtulum include its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce swelling, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
